methodology.adapterIsolation: 3 fresh Node processes per adapter with explicit garbage collection available.
methodology.checksumPolicy: Every timed sample contributes to a non-cancelling aggregate checksum.
methodology.memory: Each observation measures a fresh world; active heap is sampled before disposal and retained heap after the capture frame returns and garbage collection runs.
methodology.timing: performance.now() wall-clock milliseconds; raw observations, median, and p95 are retained.
